_comment: Clinic / med-spa supply release record. Every value comes from the issuing laboratory, the manufacturer, or regulatory counsel. Nothing here is filled in from memory, an old lot, or an estimate. Choose the posture deliberately: ruo_research_supply keeps the Research-Use-Only regime and forbids clinical representation; api_for_compounding is drug supply and requires bulk drug substance eligibility that no certificate of analysis can provide.
_comment_api_only: The block below is required only under the api_for_compounding posture. A typical Research-Use-Only certificate does not carry any of it.

regulatoryBasis._comment: A determination made by regulatory counsel and recorded here. Not inferred from the material, the supplier, or the certificate.
